decisions.title: Agent decisions
decisions.intro: Jev helps agents choose when to reply, acknowledge a message, or do follow-up work. Set the choices that matter in this channel.
decisions.enabledHelp: Saving enables these decisions for new messages. Follow-up work uses the selected agent’s existing access and approvals.
decisions.disabledHelp: These choices stay saved while Jev is off. Agents use their usual response decisions.
decisions.confidenceHelp: Low-confidence choices do not start automatic actions. Directly addressed agents can still reply.
decisions.reactionsHelp: Choose which reactions agents may use and what each one means here.
decisions.followUpHelp: Ask a question and define its possible outcomes, such as confirmed, proposed, superseded, or unrelated.
decisions.nameHelp: A short name using letters, numbers, hyphens, or underscores.
decisions.question: What should be decided?
decisions.questionPlaceholder: Has the conversation reached a decision that belongs in our decision log?
decisions.outcomeHelp: Jev chooses one outcome. Include an outcome that needs no further work.
decisions.addAgentHelp: Add an agent to this channel to ask it to follow up.
decisions.workPlaceholder: Record the decision, its reasoning, and the message link in the project's decision log.
